purpose: Teach: 消す/素早く/ニコニコ/いやあ/真っ黒/鞄/懐かしく/セーター

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、教室の電気、絶対、消す、絶対、の、絶対、忘れたぜ
lines.en: Riku, you totally forgot to turn off the classroom lights. Seriously.
lines.style: Sharp, knowing smirk. Quick rhythm like she's caught him red-handed. Slight edge of teasing affection underneath the sarcasm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、素早く、絶対、シュート、絶対、決めたな、桜
lines.en: You actually nailed that shot so fast, Sakura.
lines.style: Warm admiration, eyes bright. Genuine praise without overthinking it. Slight lift at the end—he's pleased she pulled it off.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、ニコニコ、絶対、嬉しそうだね
lines.en: Riku, you look so happy right now.
lines.style: Soft, almost vulnerable observation. Like she's noticing something she doesn't usually say out loud. Quiet affection bleeding through the surface.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いやあ、桜、お前、本気で、絶対、ヤバいぜ
lines.style: Energized, almost breathless. The words tumble out with genuine excitement. Can't quite hide how much he means it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のスニーカー、本気で、絶対、真っ黒、絶対、だぜ
lines.en: Riku, those sneakers of yours are pure black.
lines.style: Casual observation wrapped in light teasing. She's noticed something small about him, testing the waters of saying it. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、鞄、絶対、新しいの、絶対、可愛いぜ、桜
lines.en: Your new bag is really cute, Sakura.
lines.style: Direct compliment delivered softly, like he's been thinking about it. No bravado—just honest admiration. Holds the moment just slightly longer than necessary.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、小学校、本気で、絶対、懐かしく、絶対、思うね
lines.en: Riku, elementary school feels so far away now, doesn't it?
lines.style: Wistful, a little surprised by her own nostalgia. Slower pace. Voice drifts slightly as she looks back. Searching for the moment when things changed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、セーター、絶対、お洒落だな、桜
lines.en: That sweater of yours really suits you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity, almost hesitant—like he's saying something that matters. Warm and close, eyes staying on her. The kind of observation that took courage to voice.
